metadata.title: Clicked like a confused pigeon and somehow robbed that 1 poor soul? Valorant madness!
metadata.description:
Pressed every button like my mouse was possessed.
Enemy probably uninstalling or questioning life choices.
Did NOT deserve that kill but hey, chaos chose me today.
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, you’ll get this.

Hit like if your aim is more accident than skill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
